# IntelGen V2

> Hardware, software, and vintage systems from the bench — DIY computers, games, and lab experiments.

Site: https://www.intelgenv2.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/IntelGenV2/Website

## Projects

- [System Revival](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/system/system-revival/) — My motherboard repair game, from the first pencil map to the SR-8 board and its swappable chips.
- [IntelGen Game Launcher](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/intelgen/intelgen-game-launcher/) — Browse your installed games in one Windows library, link copies from different stores and play from the couch with a controller.
- [NanoLab 1](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/nanolab/nanolab/) — Arduino BASIC mini-PC with a dual-Nano CPU and VGA GPU — a real machine you can type into.
- [NanoLab 2](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/nanolab/nanolab-2/) — Nano R4 + classic Nano VGA BASIC mini-PC — dual-mode NL1/NL2, SD card, and an 8 KB program buffer.
- [Commodore 64 Projects](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/misc/commodore-64/) — My Commodore 64 games, Flash ports, disk tools and Studio 256 intro, with pictures from the builds.
- [Retro Computers](https://www.intelgenv2.com/projects/misc/retro-computers/) — Retro Computers — Commodore 64, VIC-20, Amiga 500, Apple IIe, Macintosh Plus, iMac G3, and Dell Vostro 200 XP.
